subject: Platform headcount approval & proposed compensation bands for runtime slate
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Platform headcount approval & proposed compensation bands for runtime slate

Hi Kim / Marcus —

Requesting approval to open and extend offers for a small runtime/platform slate tied to H1 throughput targets. This is budgeted but requires explicit headcount delegation and final compensation band signoff before Talent will extend offers. Summary below; full packet attached (runtime_slate_business_case.pdf) and comp-band worksheet attached.

Quick summary:
- Roles requested (total 4 FTEs):
  1) Kernel Engineer (2x IC4/IC5 mix) — critical for ongoing low-latency kernel work; 2 headcount.
  2) Runtime SRE (1x IC4) — on-call and autoscale reliability for dedicated pools.
  3) Platform SWE (1x IC5) — orchestration and rollout infra for Dedicated/Private.

- Proposed compensation bands (base + target OTE):
  * Kernel IC4: band B3 — base $175k–$195k; target comp $220k
  * Kernel IC5: band B4 — base $205k–$235k; target comp $275k
  * Runtime SRE IC4: band B3 — base $170k–$195k; target comp $215k
  * Platform SWE IC5: band B4 — base $200k–$230k; target comp $260k

Rationale: these bands are set to be competitive in bay-area market against other inference infra openings; we are prioritizing speed to hire for the kernel slots to hit v2 latency milestones in Q3. Recruiting has two strongly interested candidates for the Kernel IC5 slot and one for Platform IC5 (pipeline attached).

Ask:
1) Approve the 4 hires and delegate offer authority to Marissa (Talent) to extend up to the listed target comp for IC4s and up to the top-of-band for IC5s only with one of the two exec approvals below.
2) Confirm final band tweaks if any (Marcus, Kim) — Kim please confirm compensation band exceptions are acceptable so we can move to offer.
3) If approved, Marissa will prepare offers and we’ll run a 48-hour approve window for any exceptions.

Notes: we anticipate 12% overall increase vs base budget for these slots due to competitiveness and candidate counteroffers; full budget impact in attached workbook.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Hiring Partner, Platform & Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Platform headcount approval & proposed compensation bands for runtime slate

Naomi — thanks for the packet and the clear ask. A few follow-ups before I can greenlight: 

1) Market anchoring: can you add a quick line for each role showing 50th and 75th percentile comps (total comp) by our compensation survey (you can reference the comp-band-comparison-2027.xlsx attachment).
2) Band exceptions: I understand the urgency for IC5 kernel but I want to avoid setting a precedent. Approve delegation to Marissa to sign offers up to top-of-band for IC5 as long as we: a) include a 6-month performance clause tied to kernel milestones; b) copy me and Kim on any above-band approvals.
3) Hiring order: please prioritize 2x Kernel then Platform then SRE. If Talent needs to split offers to move quickly, document rationale in the candidate pipeline email.

If you can add the percentile lines and confirm the 6-month milestone clause, I’ll sign off this afternoon.

- Marcus
Director, Runtime & Serving
Redwood Inference

Team — I reviewed the attached band worksheet. A couple of operating constraints from my side: 

- We can approve the 4 headcount as described. Budget owner signoff is OK.
- For IC5 offers: I will approve top-of-band exceptions for up to two hires in this tranche provided: a) the role is mission-critical (agree kernel qualifies); b) we get a short write-up from Naomi with candidate-specific differentiation (e.g., open-source contributions, prior infra at scale) before the offer goes out.
- The 6-month performance clause Marcus suggested is acceptable — Talent should include it as a standard condition in the offer letter for IC5 candidates.

Marissa — please prepare offer templates that include the milestone clause and an internal justification field (2–3 lines) that Naomi will fill per candidate. Let me know if you need a delegated approval flow (Slack/DocuSign) for above-band approvals.

Kim
VP, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — I updated the comp-band-comparison worksheet with 50th/75th percentiles (see attachment) and added the candidate differentiation notes for Sarah (IC5 kernel). Quick summary of changes:

- Kernel IC5 (Sarah): 50th = $240k TC, 75th = $285k TC. Candidate expects $275k TC — we propose $270k with 6-month performance clause; include $25k sign-on spread as negotiating cushion.
- Kernel IC4: propose offer at mid-band; reserve top-of-band only if countered.
- Platform IC5: propose initial outreach to set expectation at mid-to-top band; escalate to Kim/Marcus for top-of-band.
- Runtime SRE: continue sourcing; offer once we have a second panel candidate.

Marissa — you have delegation to extend offers up to top-of-band for Kernel IC5 for Sarah provided you include the 6-month milestone clause and attach Naomi’s 2-line justification in the offer. Please copy Kim & Marcus on any above-band approvals. Proceed when ready; Talent should track counteroffer activity in the pipeline document and alert us for any sign-on requests > $30k.

I’m stamping this one approved from me — Naomi
